newsitem.title: CANADA: CUE Network, Bank Montreal unit in deal.
newsitem.headline: CUE Network, Bank Montreal unit in deal.

text.p: CUE Network Corporation said on Thursday it agreed with Cebra Inc to test a system for expanded electronic commerce services.
The technology employed in the tests will be developed by Newbridge Networks Corp, CUE said.
Cebra is a wholly owned unit of Bank of Montreal, Canada's third largest bank.
CUE previously announced an agreement with Newbridge to purchase a turnkey LMCS system if its subsidiary, Computer Radio Corporation (CRN), was granted a nationwide LMCS license by Industry Canada.
CUE said LMCS provided an opportunity for companies engaged in the electronic commerce to expand their range of service offerings.

"Cebra Inc is a market leader in electronic commerce and the ability to access a broad band wireless network makes it possible to bring new multi-media applications to markets much more rapidly," said Gordon Kaiser, chairman and chief executive of CUE.
